text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Saint Red Desire. I have manifested here."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To one day reincarnate into another world
and bring salvation to its people
is the destiny bestowed upon me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Countless hardships must surely lie ahead on that journey.
However, we shall overcome them without fail and descend upon "that sacred ground"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
